findings.claim: The inventory/rules do not close this cause class. They mix independent input guards, logically dependent guards, derived decisions and multi-part obligations, then impose the same single-input-change and single-mutant proof on all of them. Literally L-1/L-3 cannot be completed; interpreting them loosely as one passing row per ID can leave named contract behavior unproven. L-6 therefore either stops a correct executor or the executor must silently relax the frozen acceptance.

manifestations.location: L-1/L-3/L-6; E07/E09/E21; P14/P15; Q and O groups
manifestations.claim: The promised independent predicates are not independent. P15 equality to the fixed JSON string implies P14 presence/string type. Removing only P14 while keeping P15 cannot change the policy result. E07 already quantifies over every shard, overlapping E09; changing a leaf also changes derived mode/decision observations, contrary to L-1 requiring every other predicate to keep its outcome. Positive invariants such as C01/C02/C30 and diagnostics O01-O10 are properties to observe under faults, not input predicates that a correct-code fixture can make false.

The rule requires exactly one edit from one of four all-green fixtures, with K0-K7 still green. The examples themselves use non-green strict-mode setups or multiple preparatory changes. Actual current K2 rejects changing the sole run path/head/repository, masking E01-E03 before K2b. Alternate-run topology can solve masking, but L-1 must allow an explicit per-predicate healthy setup/control rather than pretending all such preparation is one edit of the fixed four fixtures.

Several IDs bundle distinct branches, domains or observables while only one target/mutant is mandatory. L-5 does not define atomic decomposition or require all named alternatives in an existing row; its clause scan also starts at section 3 while exact-match variants originate in section 2. P17 can use uppercase input and kill removal of equality with ChotB4 while a strip-normalizing implementation passes that target and accepts a forbidden leading-space value. The plan explicitly requires empty, case, whitespace, cross-class and unreadable cases. Similar bundling includes three names in E22, two missing files in Q12, CR/space/tab in C15, connection/TLS in V06 and three independent fields in O08. This is a coverage counterexample, not a claim that a complete future B4 suite has been executed.

Q14 unconditionally requires one request when (i) and (ii) are true. P01/P02 require zero requests when the repository is wrong or the read-ban variable is set, including that same state. The inventory thus contradicts the operative decision contract. This is the same inventory-normalization cause, not a separate production finding.

evidence.observed: 114 rows, groups E22/Q14/S8/C31/P21/V8/O10; arithmetic lower bound 131. P14/P15 probe: 13 JSON-domain representatives, 0 P14=false/P15=true witnesses and 0 output changes after dropping P14. Equality to the fixed string also proves the implication for the whole JSON value domain. Removing shard 7 changes both E07 and E09. Q14 has three suppressor combinations demanding 1 where sections 6/8 demand 0. P17 target: correct=khong_khop/no exception; remove-equality mutant=khop/ChotB4; strip fault=khong_khop/no exception. On leading-space input, correct=khong_khop but strip fault=khop.

Actual current-master CLI: healthy fixture rc0; sole-run path/head/repository edits each rc12 with THIẾU K2 CI and no stdout. All 53 cong_m9_* cases pass. These runs establish masking and baseline behavior, not future B4 behavior.

suggested_fix.where: SPEC.md, inventory schema and L-1..L-6, then GT-7/examples and acceptance 4. The defect is the proof contract across the whole inventory; adding another isolated row cannot repair it.
suggested_fix.how: Keep the authorized inventory approach. Distinguish independent leaf guards from derived obligations and redundant implications; record dependencies and permitted domains. Require isolation of the chosen input/fault while allowing its downstream derived observations to change. Permit documented predicate-specific setup/control pairs with K0-K7 green. Remove the impossible independent-mutation requirement for P14 by documenting its implication from exact-name equality, preserving the product contract. Decompose every bundled row or require explicit coverage of each named branch/domain/observable, including two directions and unmeasurable outcomes. Qualify Q14 by P01/P02 or distinguish entry into the read stage from actual network requests. Keep ChotB4 credit tied to the actual target exception, and keep stop-on-unproven obligations.
suggested_fix.locking_test: Run probe_proof_rules.py and probe_current.py as review counterexamples, then have the executor produce actual case/mutant runs on H. Closure requires: a consistent dependency/implication treatment for P14/P15 and E07/E09; K2-green alternate-run controls for E01-E04; separate empty/case/whitespace/cross-class P17 targets with normalization faults killed by their own ChotB4; all named sub-obligations in bundled rows; and valid-dich/valid-audit controls with P01 or P02 blocking GET. A mutant sending GET despite P02 must die on the zero-request target. A fulfilled-ID count or a different failing case is insufficient.
suggested_fix.may_spawn: More cases, mutants and evidence rows; a revised lower-bound count and measured candidate size; another spec revision subject to the exhausted author budget. Over-correcting can introduce catch-all exception credit, artificial redundant product branches, weakened isolation or out-of-scope production changes. None is authorized by this suggestion.

findings.claim: The final size receipt has a circular commit binding. KET_QUA.md is one of the five files delivered in H, but the size procedure requires measuring that exact H and recording both SHA values and its numstat in KET_QUA.md before submitting H. Committing that receipt produces a different head and potentially a different size; leaving it uncommitted means it is not the declared delivered evidence. No final external receipt or explicit two-stage binding is specified. This is a final-evidence feasibility defect, separate from the now-resolved cap timing interpretation in B4-S10.

manifestations.location: write set item 5 plus size measurement and acceptance 9
manifestations.claim: Writing final-H measurements into a tracked file contained by final H invalidates the recorded H/numstat unless the attestation carrier is explicitly separated.

evidence.observed: Disposable documentation-only Git probe: measured H=09c3e3a5bcccdd52273e5914f204742210f55659; after recording H/base/numstat in tracked KET_QUA.md, delivered H=aed30c840989a1f8e141ef62cb3f2ed95dc404e2. Equality=false. Measured additions: KET_QUA.md=1, note.md=1; delivered additions: KET_QUA.md=4, note.md=1. No reviewed repository or product source was modified.

suggested_fix.where: SPEC.md size procedure, write-set item 5 and acceptance 9; the existing do/do_b4.py measurement command is the natural output producer because it already owns the size/evidence report.
suggested_fix.how: Freeze the five-file candidate first, including its committed test report. Measure all five files on that final H and carry the final H/tree/base/numstat in an external handoff/receipt outside H. Explicitly distinguish that final attestation from earlier measurements stored in KET_QUA.md. Any change to a delivered file creates a new H and requires a new final measurement. Do not exclude KET_QUA.md from the size cap or enlarge the write set merely to evade the cycle.
suggested_fix.locking_test: A scratch measurement test accepts a receipt whose recorded head/tree and numstat match the frozen candidate, then changes and recommits KET_QUA.md and rejects the old receipt. The measurement-script mutant comparing the receipt to H’s parent, or ignoring changes in KET_QUA.md, must fail that target. This can be a test of the existing measurement script; no new product gate is required.
suggested_fix.may_spawn: A small handoff/schema clarification and external evidence artifact. Risks are accidentally measuring only product files, trusting a predecessor SHA, or changing the candidate after owner/reviewer approval. Keep the final receipt separate while counting every delivered file.
